About Daniel

Before trading lesson plans for real estate, Marcus spent years teaching high school history and coaching track—skills that come in handy every time he helps a nervous first-time buyer break down a stack of disclosures. Specializing in Alameda and the East Bay waterfront, Marcus believes nobody should feel rushed or talked down to when making the biggest purchase of their life. He brings a patient, teacher's eye to every walkthrough, making sure you actually understand the contract before you sign.

When he's not hosting weekend open house crawls or teaching monthly classes at the Alameda library, you can find him kayaking the Oakland estuary or volunteering with local youth reading programs.
